text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An era of dazzling powerhouses.
Collectively,
these racers are known as
the Golden Generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And right now, those very racers are
gathered in
my office, all for a single
purpose.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hot pot preparations, begin!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Yeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's right. They're all here today for a
hot-pot
party, and they've brought all
kinds of
ingredients with them.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! I'm so happy! I can't believe we
get to
close out the year together with a
hot-pot party!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa! Tsuru, are you crying?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yeah! These onions I'm cutting are killer!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey King, do you know how to peel
veggies?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-of course I do! Um, let's see! How do I
hold the
knife again?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hm, doesn't seem like I can take it
easy... Oh,
well. Here, hand that knife to
me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The most important thing about a hot
pot is making sure it's nice and colorful.
Adding a few
flowers should do the
job. ♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I see... Qué?! Are those dandelions
you're
putting in?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Look at all the veggies, meat, and
seafood! The pot's practically
overflowing with goodies
thanks to
everyone's contributions!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The giant hairy crab that's sitting on top
of everything makes a real impact, too!
Talk about a
centerpiece! Mm, it looks
so yummy!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: All right, let's eat!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, the atmosphere in the room
shifts
dramatically, and everyone's eyes
start gleaming
with a ferocious hunger!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Raaargh! That crab is MIIINE!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Urk! Of course everyone would start
fighting over the centerpiece right away!
I can't find a single
opening to take
advantage of!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Good work, everyone. I'll take this
opportunity to
sneak my way in... Oh,
this scallop looks about
ready.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hraaagh! Mid-Air Condor STRIKE! That
crab
belongs to me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué?! Where'd it go?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Taking the time to use a flashy move,
hm? How carefree you are, El. But you
left yourself wide
open, and now the
crab is mine.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Not so fast! This fight isn't over yet!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, that was so yummy! I'm stuffed!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Spe? What are you giggling about?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Well, I was just thinking about how this
hot-pot
party was like being in a race
with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The meal turned out great because we're
all here. It was fun both cooking
together and fighting
playfully over our
food.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's the same during races—we run
together and
do our best to come out on
top...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Of course none of us want to lose, but
even then,
we do whatever we can to
support each other.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It just struck me that everything has
been so fun
because you're all along for
the ride.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. What a lovely way to end our
night. That
was very touching, Spe.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But although the night may be drawing
to a close, our days of racing are far
from over. We still have
plenty of battles
left on the track.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know. But I'll be the last one to
stand on
the winner's podium! That's a
promise!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Just like I claimed victory over the
hot-pot party
tonight! Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week beams—the big, empty
crab shell
lying picked clean on her
plate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Golden Generation looks back on
the days they've shared together and
renews their vow to
continue racing
toward tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
We won't let you win that easily, though.
After
all, claiming that crab wasn't so
easy, now was it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Right. After all that fuss, we just ended
up sharing
it... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh well! Let's just call it a draw for
today! Now,
it's time to make some
porridge with the
leftovers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Golden Generation looks back on
the days they've shared together and
renews their vow to
continue racing
toward tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I know I let victory slip through my fingers today... But it won't happen again! Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Slightly confused, I follow her gaze
down to see... Her now empty plate,
without so much as a single crab leg
shell. Guess she didn't manage to snag 
any...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Golden Generation looks back on
the days they've shared together and
renew their vow to
continue racing
toward tomorrow.
